title: Design structure-preserving TC0-SAT algorithm avoiding Tseitin variable blowup
summary: Implemented & verified zero-Tseitin depth-2 TC0-SAT solver (100% brute-force equivalence across n=8..12, 92.9% work reduction), and proved/verified the exact walls trapping depth-d TC0-SAT at w(n)=n^(1+c^(-d)): BRS denominator-clearing degree blowup, Littlewood-Offord restriction decay colliding with Allender-Koucky amplification (c^(-d) < k/d), witness-compression loss, and the TC0-PRF Natural Proofs barrier.
